name: TooltipSystem
src_typeComment: Singleton that shows/hides a single tooltip panel following the cursor. Add one to your UI Canvas, assign the panel + text, then call TooltipSystem.Instance.Show("text") from anywhere — or just add TooltipTrigger to individual UI elements for zero-code hover tooltips.

src_serialized.name: panel
src_serialized.tooltip: The panel containing the tooltip background + text, toggled on/off.

src_serialized.name: label
src_serialized.tooltip: Text component the tooltip message is written to.

src_serialized.name: cursorOffset
src_serialized.tooltip: Offset from the cursor in screen pixels.
